sourceRefs.locator: National Archives Identifier 6120319, 185-G-16-1514, August 1919. National Archives Foundation, DocsTeach, “Citation” and item-specific “Rights: Public Domain”. The photographer is unnamed. The lower edge of the surviving print reads 284-X8, whereas the DocsTeach transcription renders 248-X8. Both identify the same image by title, month and NAID.

alt.de: Patienten liegen in zwei Reihen Metallbetten am gefliesten Mittelgang. Pflegekräfte stehen zwischen den Betten, links vorn ist ein Schreibtisch zu sehen. Auf dem unteren Bildrand ist die damalige Bezeichnung „Spanish“ lesbar.
alt.en: Patients lie in two rows of metal beds beside a tiled central aisle. Staff stand among the beds. A desk appears at the front left. The original caption at the foot of the print includes the word “Spanish”.

creators: The Panama Canal, United States government (photographer unidentified)
